profile.summary: Replate is a nonprofit that runs a food rescue program. It connects businesses that have extra edible food with food banks, shelters and other nonprofits that serve people who do not have enough to eat. It began in Berkeley, California in 2016 and now operates in the San Francisco Bay Area and several other U.S. regions.
